title: Airplane Bathrooms Have No Window
caption:
Airplane bathrooms have no window

Every other part of the cabin has one, and the bathroom does not. A window is a hole cut into the fuselage, and every hole needs extra structure around it so the shell keeps its strength. That is weight the plane carries on every single flight, for a room you use for two minutes. The bathroom also sits deep inside the cabin, well away from the outer wall, so there is nothing to look through anyway.

Next time you are in one, the missing window is not an oversight.

Send this to the person you always fly with.

Follow for a new one every day.

job.narration: Most airplane bathrooms have no window. A window means extra weight and a weak spot in the plane's shell. The bathroom sits deep inside anyway. So the window was left out.
